topic_title: Vice President of India — Election, Powers & Constitutional Provisions

learning_outcomes: Articles 63-71: Complete constitutional scheme of VP's office
Electoral College trap: VP vs President election difference
Election method - Proportional Representation & Single Transferable Vote
Term, oath, resignation and removal process (effective majority)
VP as ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha - powers & limitations
VP acting as President (Article 65) - historical instances
Complete list of Vice Presidents with PYQ trivia facts

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, tumhare gaanv ki panchayat mein Sarpanch to hote hi hain na? Ek sawaal - agar Sarpanch kisi kaam se bahar chale jaayein ya bimaar pad jaayein, gaanv ka kaam kaun sambhalta hai?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Up-Sarpanch sir! Wahi to Sarpanch ke baad sabse bada aadmi hota hai panchayat mein.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pakda tumne! Ab poore desh ke level pe socho - agar aisa hi ek pad ho, jo President ke baad desh ka doosra sabse bada constitutional pad ho, to?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aisa bhi koi pad hota hai kya sir? Mujhe to bas President aur Prime Minister hi pata hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan hota hai Raju, aur uska naam hai 'Vice President of India' - hindi mein Up-Rashtrapati. Yehi desh ka doosra sabse bada constitutional pad hai, President ke turant baad.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa... to VP bhi President jitna hi powerful hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi Raju, actual powers mein VP, President se bahut kam powerful hai. Lekin 'Warrant of Precedence' yaani protocol ranking mein VP number 2 pe aata hai - President ke baad, aur Prime Minister se bhi pehle!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? PM se bhi pehle?? Ye to exam mein pakka trap banega sir!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab dhyan se suno - VP se juda pura vidhan Constitution ke Part V (Union Executive) mein, Article 63 se 71 tak diya gaya hai. Isi Part mein President, VP, PM aur Council of Ministers sabka zikr hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Itne saare Articles?? Sir, ye sab yaad kaise rakhun, mix ho jaayenge!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ghabrao mat, hum ek-ek karke, step-by-step samjhenge. Sabse pehla hai Article 63 - jo bas itna kehta hai: 'Bharat ka ek Vice-President hoga.' Baaki articles uske election, term, powers detail mein batate hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Theek hai sir, par ye batao - VP roz karta kya hai? Uska kaam kya hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut badhiya sawaal! VP ke do main kaam hain. Pehla - Article 64 ke तहत wo Rajya Sabha ka 'ex-officio Chairman' hota hai, yaani Rajya Sabha ki meetings chalata hai. Doosra - Article 65 ke तहत, agar President ka pad khaali ho jaaye ya President kaam na kar paayein, to VP unki jagah kaam sambhalta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab VP ek tarah se 'standby President' bhi hai aur Rajya Sabha ka 'class monitor' bhi! Do kaam ek saath?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi samjha! Ye dono roles bahut alag hain aur exam mein dono ke baare mein alag-alag traps aate hain. Ab hum ek-ek karke inhe puri tarah kholenge - pehle dekhte hain, VP banne ke liye qualification kya chahiye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Chalo sir, dekhte hain kaun VP ban sakta hai!

quiz_payload.question: Vice President of India ke pad ka ullekh Constitution ke kis Article mein hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 63 simply states - 'There shall be a Vice-President of India.' Article 64 VP ko RS ka Chairman banata hai, Article 66 election se sambandhit hai.

quiz_payload.question: Warrant of Precedence (Protocol ranking) mein Vice President ka sthaan kahan hai?

options.text: President ke baad, Prime Minister se pehle

quiz_payload.explanation: VP protocol mein number 2 par aata hai - President ke turant baad, aur Prime Minister se bhi pehle. Ye SSC/Railway ka classic direct fact-based question hai.

quiz_payload.question:
Nimnlikhit kathanon par vichar karein:
1) Vice President, Rajya Sabha ka ex-officio Chairman hota hai.
2) Vice President, Rajya Sabha ka sadasya (member) bhi hota hai.
Upayukt kathan chuniye:
quiz_payload.explanation: Ye BPSC ka favourite trap hai! VP Rajya Sabha ka Chairman zaroor hota hai, lekin wo Rajya Sabha ka sadasya (member) NAHI hota. Ye detail aage Module 7 mein aur gehraai se samjhenge.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Har officer ki journey ek chhote se step se shuru hoti hai - tumne wo step le liya hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab batao Raju, agar tumhare school mein 'Head Boy' chunna ho, to kya koi bhi Class 1 ka bachcha khada ho sakta hai?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nahi sir, wo to bahut chhota hai! Kam se kam bade class ka koi senior hi ban sakta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul waisa hi VP ke liye bhi minimum age tय hai. Article 66(3) ke तहत, VP banne ke liye वह व्यक्ति Bharat ka nagrik hona chahiye aur uski umra kam se kam 35 saal honi chahiye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 35 saal? Ye to President wali age jaisi hi lag rahi hai... President ke liye bhi 35 hi tha na sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi Raju! President aur VP dono ke liye minimum age 35 saal hai - ye common fact bhool mat jaana. Ab teesri condition suno - VP ko 'Rajya Sabha ka member banne yogya' hona chahiye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab Lok Sabha wali qualification kaam nahi karegi? Sirf Rajya Sabha wali?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pakda! Ye ek subtle par important point hai - VP ke liye Rajya Sabha membership ki eligibility chahiye, na ki Lok Sabha ki. Yaad rakho, President ke liye Lok Sabha ki qualification chahiye hoti hai, VP ke liye Rajya Sabha ki - ulta trap yahin bantа hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa!! President = Lok Sabha wali qualification, VP = Rajya Sabha wali qualification. Ye to seedha ulta trap hai exam mein!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab ek aur zaroori shart - VP kisi 'office of profit' (labh ka pad) par nahi hona chahiye. Matlab wo koi aisi sarkari naukri nahi kar raha ho jisse usse salary milti ho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To sir, agar koi already Governor hai ya Minister hai, to kya wo VP nahi ban sakta?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut achha doubt! Yahan ek exception hai - President, Governor, ya kisi State/Union ke Minister ka pad 'office of profit' nahi maana jaata is context mein. Isliye ye log VP banne ke eligible hote hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab exception mein President-Governor-Minister sab bach jaate hain! Ye to yaad rakhna padega.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ek last twist suno - agar koi sitting MP (Lok Sabha ya Rajya Sabha ka current member) VP chuna jaata hai, to Article 66(4) ke तहत uski MP wali seat automatically khaali maani jaati hai jis din wo VP ka pad grahan karta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab wo dono pad ek saath nahi rakh sakta - MP bhi aur VP bhi? Seat chhodni hi padegi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Kyunki VP khud Parliament ka member nahi hota - wo sirf Rajya Sabha ka Chairman hota hai, member nahi. Isliye dono pad saath mein nahi chal sakte.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ab samajh aaya sir - ye baat pichle module wale trap se bhi connect ho rahi hai!

quiz_payload.question: VP banne ke liye minimum umra aur kis sadan ki membership yogyata chahiye?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 66(3) ke तहत VP ke liye minimum umra 35 saal hai, aur usse Rajya Sabha ka member banne yogya hona chahiye (na ki Lok Sabha ka).

quiz_payload.question: Nimnlikhit mein se kisko VP chunav ke liye 'office of profit' rakhne ke bawjood ayogya nahi maana jaata?
quiz_payload.explanation: President, Governor, aur Union/State Minister ka pad is context mein 'office of profit' nahi mana jaata - ye VP chunav ke liye special exemption hai.

quiz_payload.question: Agar Lok Sabha ka koi sitting MP VP chuna jata hai, to uski MP seat ka kya hota hai?

options.text: Wo dono pad saath rakh sakta hai
Uski Lok Sabha seat VP pad grahan karte hi khaali ho jaati hai
Uski seat par phir se chunav Speaker karayenge sirf 1 saal baad
Wo apni MP seat kisi ko de sakta hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 66(4) ke anusar, VP pad grahan karte hi uski Parliament ki seat automatically vacant maani jaati hai, kyunki VP khud Parliament ka sadasya nahi hota.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Chhota-chhota qualification bhi bada trap ban sakta hai - ab tum in traps ko pehchan sakte ho!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab sabse important aur sabse zyada trap wala topic - VP kaise chuna jaata hai? Ye vote kaun dete hain? Isse 'Electoral College' kehte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, ye to President wala hi hoga na? Sansad aur state assembly ke log vote denge?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Yahin sabse bada twist hai Raju! VP ke Electoral College mein KEWAL Sansad ke dono sadan - Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha - ke sadasya vote karte hain. Article 66(1) ye batata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab State Assembly ke MLA log VP ke chunav mein vote nahi denge?? Ye to President se bilkul alag ho gaya!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pakda! President ke chunav mein State Assembly ke elected MLAs (Delhi aur Puducherry samet) vote dete hain, lekin VP ke chunav mein KOI bhi state legislature member - na MLA, na MLC - vote nahi deta.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir ye to seedha ulta ho gaya! President = Parliament + State Assembly, VP = sirf Parliament. Ye to exam mein pakka confuse karega!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul, isliye BPSC aur UPSC dono is comparison par baar-baar sawaal banate hain. Ek line mein yaad rakho - 'VP ke chunav mein sirf Sansad, state ka koi role nahi.'

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Theek hai sir, likh liya! Par ab batao - Sansad ke saare members vote karte hain kya, ya kuch chhut jaate hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut badhiya sawaal, aur yahan doosra bada twist hai! President ke chunav mein Parliament ke 'nominated members' vote NAHI de sakte. Lekin VP ke chunav mein wahi nominated members bhi vote de sakte hain!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? President mein exclude, VP mein include? Ye to bilkul ulta rule hai sir!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi Raju - Rajya Sabha mein 12 members President dwara naामित (nominated) kiye jaate hain - sahitya, vigyan, kala, samaj sewa jaise kshetra se. Ye 12 log President ke chunav mein vote nahi de sakte, par VP ke chunav mein zaroor de sakte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye to yaad rakhna zaroori hai - 'VP election mein Sansad ke elected + nominated dono, lekin sirf Sansad, state kuch nahi.'

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ⭐ BPSC TRE Favorite: Raju, tumhe pata hai Bihar mein Vidhan Sabha ke saath-saath Vidhan Parishad (Legislative Council) bhi hai - matlab Bihar bicameral state hai. Bihar ke MLC log kya kabhi President ya VP ke chunav mein vote de sakte hain?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir MLA log to President mein vote dete hain na, to MLC bhi denge shaayad?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi Raju! Ye classic BPSC trap hai - Legislative Council (MLC) ke members chahe kisi bhi state ke hon (Bihar, UP, Maharashtra), unhe na President ke chunav mein vote ka adhikar hai, na VP ke chunav mein. Sirf elected MLA (Vidhan Sabha members) ko President chunav mein role milta hai, VP chunav mein to unhe bhi nahi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa!! To Bihar Vidhan Parishad ke members ka in dono hi chunav mein koi role nahi. Ye to bahut zaroori fact hai Bihar exams ke liye!

quiz_payload.question: Vice President ke Electoral College mein kaun shaamil hota hai?

options.text: Sirf Lok Sabha ke elected sadasya
Sansad ke dono sadan ke elected aur nominated sadasya
Sansad ke sadasya + State Vidhan Sabha ke sadasya
Sansad ke sadasya + State Vidhan Parishad ke sadasya

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 66(1) ke anusar VP ke electoral college mein Lok Sabha aur Rajya Sabha ke elected AUR nominated dono tarah ke sadasya vote dete hain, State legislature ka koi role nahi hota.

quiz_payload.question: Nimnlikhit mein se kaun President aur VP ke election mein sabse bada antar hai?

options.text: President mein State Assembly shaamil hai, VP mein nahi; VP mein nominated members vote karte hain, President mein nahi
Dono election bilkul same tarike se hote hain
VP ke election mein State Assembly bhi shaamil hoti hai
President ke election mein nominated members vote karte hain

quiz_payload.explanation: Ye sabse important comparison hai: President ka electoral college = Parliament (elected) + State/UT Assembly (elected), nominated members exclude. VP ka electoral college = Parliament (elected + nominated), State legislature ka koi role nahi.

quiz_payload.question: VP ke chunav mein Bihar Vidhan Parishad (MLC) ke sadasyon ki bhoomika kya hoti hai?

options.text: Wo vote de sakte hain kyunki Bihar bicameral state hai
Unka VP chunav mein koi role nahi hota - MLC kabhi bhi president/VP dono chunav mein vote nahi dete
Sirf President ke chunav mein vote de sakte hain
Sirf Rajya Sabha nominate karte samay vote dete hain

quiz_payload.explanation: ⭐ BPSC TRE Favorite: Legislative Council (MLC) ke sadasya kisi bhi state ke हों, unhe na President ke chunav mein aur na hi VP ke chunav mein vote ka adhikar hota hai.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Ye sabse bada trap tha aur tumne crack kar liya! Ab officer level ki taraf badh rahe ho.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab dekhte hain vote kaise dala jaata hai. Socho, tumhe class mein 3 monitor candidates pasand hain - Ramesh, Suresh, Mahesh. Agar tumhe sirf ek hi naam likhna ho, par tumhari pehli pasand haar jaaye, to tumhara vote बेकar chala jaayega na?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan sir, aisa hota hai kai baar.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Isi problem ko solve karne ke liye VP ke chunav mein 'Proportional Representation by means of Single Transferable Vote (STV)' system use hota hai. Isme voter apni pasand ke candidates ko 1, 2, 3 preference order mein likhta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa! Matlab agar meri pehli pasand haar jaaye, to mera vote doosri pasand ko transfer ho jaata hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi samjha! Yehi 'Single Transferable Vote' ka core idea hai - koi bhi vote waste nahi jaata. Aur Article 66(1) ye bhi kehta hai ki voting 'secret ballot' se hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Secret ballot matlab? Sabko pata nahi chalega kisne kisko vote diya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi - koi bhi MP publicly nahi bataata ki usne kisko vote diya. Isse party whip ka pressure kam hota hai aur MP apni marzi se vote de sakta hai (halaanki practically party discipline follow hoti hai).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Interesting! To sir, ye same system President ke chunav mein bhi use hota hai kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan Raju, ye method (PR by STV, secret ballot) President aur VP dono ke chunav mein same hai - sirf electoral college alag hai jo humne pichhle module mein padha. Ab ek practical baat suno - koi bhi candidate VP ke liye khada hone ke liye kam se kam 20 proposers (prastaावak) aur 20 seconders (samarthak) chahiye, jo Sansad ke sadasya hon.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur security deposit jaisa kuch hota hai kya sir, jaise normal election mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul, candidate ko Rs 15,000 security deposit dena padta hai. Agar wo total valid votes ka 1/6th (ek-shashthaansh) hissa bhi na le paaye, to ye deposit zabt (forfeit) ho jaata hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Aur agar kisi ka chunav mein dispute ho jaaye, jaise dhandhli ka ilzaam, to kaun faisla karega?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut important sawaal! Article 71(1) ke anusar, VP ke chunav se juda koi bhi vivad (dispute) ka faisla kewal Supreme Court karta hai - iska 'exclusive original jurisdiction' hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: High Court ya koi aur court nahi jaa sakte kya sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul nahi, sirf Supreme Court. Aur Article 71(4) ek aur zaroori baat kehta hai - agar electoral college mein kuch seats khaali (vacant) hon, tab bhi election ko challenge nahi kiya jaa sakta sirf isi wajah se.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha matlab poora electoral college complete hone ka wait nahi karte, jitne available hain unhi se chunav ho jaata hai!

quiz_payload.question: VP ka chunav kis paddhati (method) se hota hai?

options.text: Proportional Representation by means of Single Transferable Vote, secret ballot dwara

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 66(1) ke anusar VP ka chunav Proportional Representation by means of Single Transferable Vote system se, secret ballot ke through hota hai - same method President ke liye bhi use hota hai.

quiz_payload.question: VP chunav ke liye candidate ki security deposit kitni hoti hai, aur kab zabt hoti hai?

options.text: Rs 15,000; agar 1/6th valid votes na milein

quiz_payload.explanation: Candidate ko Rs 15,000 deposit karni padti hai; agar wo total valid votes ka 1/6th hissa bhi na le paaye to deposit zabt ho jaati hai.

quiz_payload.question: VP ke chunav se sambandhit vivad (dispute) ka nirnay kaun karta hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 71(1) ke anusar sirf Supreme Court ko VP/President chunav vivadon par exclusive original jurisdiction hai aur uska faisla antim hota hai.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Election method crack ho gaya! Ab dekhte hain VP kitne saal ke liye chunа jaata hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, VP ka term (kaal-avadhi) kitne saal ka hota hai, guess karo?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: President wala 5 saal hi hoga sir, VP bhi Union executive mein hai to same hi hoga shaayad?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi guess! VP ka term bhi 5 saal ka hota hai, apne office grahan karne ki tareekh se. Aur ek achhi baat - wo dobara election lad sakta hai, chahe kitni bhi baar - koi limit nahi hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Koi limit nahi?? America mein to President sirf 2 baar hi ban sakta hai na sir? India mein VP unlimited baar ban sakta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi Raju! India mein VP (aur President dono) ki re-election par koi limit nahi hai - ye US se bilkul alag hai, jahan President sirf 2 term hi le sakta hai. Dr. Radhakrishnan to lagatar 2 baar VP rahe the!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha ek doubt sir - agar VP ka 5 saal poora ho jaaye lekin naya VP abhi chuna hi na gaya ho, to kya office khaali reh jaata hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut sharp sawaal! Nahi, Article 67 mein ek proviso hai - VP apne term khatam hone ke bawjood tab tak pad par bana rahता hai jab tak uska successor pad grahan na kar le. Isse power vacuum nahi banta.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa! Matlab chair kabhi khaali nahi rehti - naya VP aane tak purana hi kaam sambhalta rehta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab suno oath (shapath) ki baat - Article 69 ke anusar VP ko shapath President dilaate hain (ya President dwara niyukt koi vyakti). Par ek chhota, subtle fark yaad rakhna - VP ki shapath sirf 'Constitution ke prati sacchi nishtha rakhne aur apna kartavya imandari se nibhaane' ki hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isme special kya hai sir? President ki shapath bhi to yahi hogi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Yahin BPSC ka trap hai! President ki shapath (Article 60) mein ek extra line hoti hai - 'Constitution aur kanoon ki raksha, sanrakshan aur bachaav karunga (preserve, protect and defend)'. VP ki shapath mein ye extra line NAHI hoti!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? Itna chhota sa fark! Ye to bahut hi tricky hai, mujhe alag se yaad karna padega.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab last cheez is module ki - agar VP resign karna chahe, to wo apna resignation letter kisko de? Guess karo!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Speaker ko denge shaayad, jaise koi minister PM ko resign karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi Raju, Article 67(a) ke anusar VP apna resignation likhit roop mein President ko sौंpta hai - Speaker ya kisi aur ko nahi. Yaad rakho - resignation likha jaata hai, PRESIDENT ko!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! To President resign kare to kisko de? Wo bhi VP ko denge kya?

quiz_payload.question: VP apna resignation letter kisko sौंpta hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 67(a) ke anusar VP apna resignation likhit roop mein President ko dete hain. (Yaad rahe: President apna resignation VP ko dete hain - Article 56(1)(a), ye reverse pattern hai!)

quiz_payload.question:
Nimnlikhit statements par vichar karein:
1) President ki shapath mein Constitution ke 'preserve, protect aur defend' karne ka ullekh hota hai.
2) VP ki shapath mein bhi yahi 'preserve, protect, defend' wali line hoti hai.
Sahi kathan chuniye:
quiz_payload.explanation: Ye classic BPSC trap hai. President ki shapath (Article 60) mein 'preserve, protect and defend the Constitution' wali extra line hoti hai, jo VP ki shapath (Article 69) mein NAHI hoti - VP sirf 'true faith and allegiance' aur 'faithfully discharge duty' ki shapath leta hai.

quiz_payload.question: VP apne 5 saal ka term poora hone ke baad bhi office mein tab tak kyun banа rehta hai jab tak naya VP na aa jaaye?

options.text: Kyunki Article 67 ke proviso mein ye vyavastha di gayi hai taaki power vacuum na bane
Kyunki Supreme Court order deti hai
Kyunki VP ka term dara sakta hai
Aisi koi vyavastha nahi hai, VP turant hata diya jaata hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 67 ke proviso ke anusar VP apna term poora hone ke baad bhi, jab tak naya successor pad grahan na kar le, tab tak office mein bana rehta hai - taaki continuity bani rahe.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Shapath wala trap bhi crack ho gaya! Ab dekhte hain VP ko hataya kaise jaata hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, tumne 'President ka impeachment' ke baare mein suna hoga - do sadan mile ke President ko hata sakte hain kisi bhi Constitution ke violation par. Kya VP ko bhi 'impeach' kiya jaata hai?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan sir, VP bhi to President jaisa hi bada pad hai, to usko bhi impeach hi karenge na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi Raju! Yahin sabse bada trap hai - VP ko 'impeach' NAHI kiya jaata. Uski removal process bahut simple hai aur Article 67(b) mein diya gaya hai. Impeachment sirf President ke liye use hota hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa! To VP ko kaise hataya jaata hai phir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: VP ke removal ka resolution KEWAL Rajya Sabha mein hi laaya ja sakta hai - Lok Sabha mein nahi! Kyunki VP RS ka ex-officio Chairman hota hai, isliye removal RS se hi shuru hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab Lok Sabha ise start nahi kar sakti? Sirf approve kar sakti hai baad mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Resolution RS mein 14 din ka advance notice dekar laaya jaata hai. Iske baad ye Lok Sabha ke paas jaata hai approval ke liye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: President ke impeachment mein to kisi bhi sadan se shuru ho sakta hai na sir, ye VP wala to bilkul opposite hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi Raju! Ab majority ki baat karte hain - Rajya Sabha mein ye resolution 'effective majority' se paas hona chahiye, aur phir Lok Sabha mein 'simple majority' se agree hona chahiye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, 'effective majority' kya hoti hai? Simple majority se alag kaise?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Achha sawaal! Simple majority matlab us din present aur voting karne walon ka majority. Effective majority matlab total sadasyon ka majority, lekin usme se khaali (vacant) seats ghatakar. Ye simple majority se thoda zyada strict hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, to RS mein strict wali majority, aur LS mein normal wali - ye combination yaad rakhna padega.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab dono ko side-by-side yaad karo. President: impeachment, kisi bhi sadan se shuru, dono sadan mein 2/3rd majority chahiye (total membership ka), 14 din notice, specific charge (Constitution violation) zaroori. VP: sirf RS se shuru, RS mein effective majority + LS mein simple majority, 14 din notice, koi specific charge/ground batana zaroori nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wait sir, VP ko hataane ke liye koi wajah batani hi nahi padti?? Aise hi hata sakte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pakda - Constitution ne VP removal ke liye koi specific ground define nahi kiya, jaise President ke liye 'violation of Constitution' likha hai. Ye VP removal ko President ke muqable kaafi zyada simple bana deta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye to bahut bada difference hai sir! President ko hataana kitna mushkil, VP ko utna aasan!

quiz_payload.question: VP ko hataane ka resolution kis sadan mein shuru kiya ja sakta hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 67(b) ke anusar VP ke removal ka resolution KEWAL Rajya Sabha mein hi laaya ja sakta hai, kyunki VP RS ka ex-officio Chairman hota hai.

quiz_payload.question: VP ko hataane ke liye required majority kya hai?

options.text: RS mein effective majority, LS mein simple majority

quiz_payload.explanation: Resolution ko Rajya Sabha mein effective majority se paas hokar Lok Sabha mein simple majority se agree hona chahiye - ye President ke 2/3rd wale impeachment se kaafi alag aur aasaan hai.

quiz_payload.question:
Assertion (A): VP ko hataane ke liye Constitution mein koi specific ground (charge) define nahi kiya gaya hai.
Reason (R): VP ka removal 'impeachment' procedure se hota hai jaisa President ka hota hai.
Sahi vikalp chuniye:

options.text: A aur R dono sahi hain, aur R, A ki sahi vyakhya hai
A sahi hai, lekin R galat hai
A galat hai, lekin R sahi hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Assertion sahi hai - koi ground define nahi hai. Lekin Reason galat hai kyunki VP ka removal 'impeachment' se NAHI hota, ye sirf effective+simple majority wale resolution se hota hai, jo President ke impeachment se bilkul alag process hai.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Removal process ka trap bhi tumne solve kar liya - ab aage RS Chairman wala role dekhte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab detail mein samjhte hain VP ka RS wala role. Article 64 ke anusar VP automatically Rajya Sabha ka Chairman ban jaata hai - use koi alag se chunav nahi ladna padta ye position paane ke liye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab VP ban gaye to Chairman apne aap ban jaate hain? Bina kisi extra vote ke?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi - isiliye ise 'ex-officio' Chairman kehte hain, matlab 'pad ke karan (by virtue of office)' mila hua position. Compare karo Lok Sabha ke Speaker se, jise LS ke members khud apne mein se chunte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! To Speaker LS ka member hote hue bhi chuna jaata hai, lekin VP Rajya Sabha ka Chairman hote hue bhi member nahi hota - ye wahi trap hai jo humne shuru mein dekha tha!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi yaad rakha! Ab ek aur important baat - kyunki VP RS ka member nahi hota, isliye wo normal proceedings mein vote nahi de sakta. Lekin ek exception hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Exception? Kaunsa sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Agar kisi bill ya matter par voting mein barabar (tie) vote aa jaaye, tab VP apna 'casting vote' de sakta hai taaki tie tood sake. Ye Article 100(1) mein diya gaya hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab normally chup, par tie hone par decider ban jaate hain! Interesting rule hai ye to.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab ek aur bada twist suno - agar Rajya Sabha ke members khud VP ko Chairman ke pad se hatana chahein, to kya wo aisa kar sakte hain?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan kyun nahi, jaise Speaker ko Lok Sabha hata sakti hai, waise RS bhi apne Chairman ko hata degi!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi Raju! Yahi sabse bada trap hai - RS apne aap VP ko Chairman ke pad se NAHI hata sakti. VP ko Chairman ke pad se hataane ka ek hi tarika hai - use PURI TARAH VP ke pad se hi hataya jaaye (Article 67(b) wali process se).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hain?? Matlab Chairman-ship alag se nahi ja sakti, VP ka pura pad hi jaana padega? Ye to Speaker se bilkul ulta hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi samjha! Ab ek related pad - Rajya Sabha khud apne mein se ek 'Deputy Chairman' bhi chunती hai (Article 89(1)). Ye asli Rajya Sabha ka member hota hai, VP ki tarah bahar se aaya hua nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To Deputy Chairman kab kaam aata hai sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Jab VP ka pad khaali ho, ya VP Rajya Sabha ki meeting attend na kar paayein, ya VP 'acting President' ban jaayein - tab Deputy Chairman RS ki meetings chalata hai. Aur is Deputy Chairman ko RS khud, effective majority se, 14 din notice dekar hata bhi sakti hai (Article 90).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! To Deputy Chairman ko hataana RS ke apne haath mein hai, lekin VP ko Chairman-ship se hataana RS ke haath mein bilkul nahi - kya zabardast trap hai ye!

quiz_payload.question: Rajya Sabha mein tie (barabar vote) hone ki sthiti mein kaun casting vote deta hai?

options.text: VP (Chairman) apna casting vote de sakta hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 100(1) ke anusar VP, jo RS ka ex-officio Chairman hai, normal voting mein vote nahi deta lekin tie hone par casting vote de sakta hai.

quiz_payload.question: Kya Rajya Sabha VP ko sirf 'Chairman' ke pad se hata sakti hai, jabki wo VP hi bana rahe?

options.text: Nahi, VP ko Chairman-ship se hataane ka ek hi tarika hai - use pura VP pad se hi hataya jaaye
Nahi, kewal Supreme Court hi hata sakti hai

quiz_payload.explanation: VP Chairman ke pad se sirf tabhi hat sakta hai jab use poori tarah VP ke pad se hi hataya jaaye (Article 67(b) prakriya se). Rajya Sabha akele use Chairman se nahi hata sakti.

quiz_payload.question: Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha ke baare mein kaunsa kathan sahi hai?

options.text: Wo Rajya Sabha ke sadasyon dwara khud apne mein se chuna jaata hai (Article 89)
Wo President dwara nominate kiya jaata hai
Wo Lok Sabha ke sadasyon mein se chuna jaata hai
Use kabhi hataya nahi ja sakta

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 89(1) ke anusar Rajya Sabha apne sadasyon mein se hi Deputy Chairman chunती hai. Use effective majority ke resolution se, 14 din notice dekar (Article 90) hataya bhi ja sakta hai.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.completed_topic: VP as Chairman of Rajya Sabha
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: RS wala role poora clear ho gaya! Ab dekhte hain VP kab 'Acting President' banता hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab wapas us Up-Sarpanch wale example par aate hain jo humne shuruaat mein dekha tha. Article 65 kehta hai - agar President ka pad khaali ho jaaye (death, resignation, removal ya kisi aur karan se), to naya President chunے jaane tak VP hi President ka kaam sambhalta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab VP khud 'President' ban jaata hai puri tarah se?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, wo President ke sabhi powers, immunities, aur salary/allowances leta hai jab tak naya President na aa jaaye (jo 6 mahine ke andar aana zaroori hai as per Article 62).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, to kya iska matlab ye hai ki tab VP Rajya Sabha ka Chairman ka kaam bhi karta rahega saath mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut achha doubt! Nahi Raju - jab VP 'acting President' banta hai, tab wo Rajya Sabha Chairman ke duties NAHI nibhata. Wo kaam tab Deputy Chairman sambhalta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa! Matlab ek waqt mein wo dono jagah kaam nahi kar sakta - ek chhodna hi padega temporarily.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Ab ek aur subtle point - Article 65(1) 'vacancy' ki baat karta hai (jaise death/resignation/removal), jabki Article 65(2) ek alag situation batata hai - jab President 'absent, ill, ya kisi aur karan' se apna kaam temporarily NAHI kar paa rahe (lekin pad khaali nahi hua).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir dono mein kya fark hai practically?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Article 65(1) mein pad khaali hota hai, isliye VP naye President ke aane tak 'act' karta hai. Article 65(2) mein President ka pad khaali nahi hota, sirf temporarily kaam nahi kar paa rahe - to VP sirf tab tak un ke functions 'discharge' karta hai jab tak President wapas kaam sambhal na le.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, to ek permanent jaisa hai aur ek temporary! Par sir, agar VP ka pad bhi khaali ho aur President ka bhi - tab kya hoga?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Zabardast sawaal! Aisi sthiti mein Article 70 kaam aata hai - Parliament ne 'President (Discharge of Functions) Act, 1969' banaya hai, jiske anusar aisi condition mein Chief Justice of India (ya sabse senior Supreme Court judge) President ke functions discharge karte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wow, itna deep-level backup plan bhi hai! Kya kabhi aisa hua bhi hai India mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan Raju, ye asal jeevan mein bhi ho chuka hai! 1969 mein President Dr. Zakir Husain ki office mein hi death ho gayi thi - tab VP V. V. Giri 'acting President' bane. Phir jab Giri khud President ka chunav ladne ke liye resign kar gaye, tab CJI Mohammad Hidayatullah ne President ke functions discharge kiye - kyunki VP ka pad bhi khaali tha!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wow, matlab dono baar backup use hua! Aur koi example hai sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, 1977 mein President Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed ki bhi office mein hi death ho gayi - tab VP B. D. Jatti 'acting President' bane. Ye dono real-life examples PYQ mein baar-baar puche jaate hain, isliye achhe se yaad rakho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Zakir Husain -> Giri, aur Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed -> Jatti. Ye to yaad ho gaya sir!

quiz_payload.question: Jab VP 'Acting President' banta hai, tab Rajya Sabha ke Chairman ka kaam kaun sambhalta hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Jab VP Article 65 ke तहत President ka kaam sambhalta hai, tab Rajya Sabha ki Chairmanship Deputy Chairman ko transfer ho jaati hai.

quiz_payload.question: Agar President aur VP dono ke pad ek saath khaali ho jaayein, to President ke functions kaun discharge karta hai?

options.text: Chief Justice of India (President Discharge of Functions Act, 1969 ke tahat)
Koi nahi, naya election hone tak governance ruk jaati hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Article 70 ke तहत bane 'President (Discharge of Functions) Act, 1969' ke anusar aisi sthiti mein Chief Justice of India (ya senior most Supreme Court judge) President ke functions discharge karte hain.

quiz_payload.question: Nimnlikhit joda (pairs) mein se kaunsa sahi sumelit hai (President death -> Acting President bana VP)?
quiz_payload.explanation: 1969 mein President Zakir Husain ki office mein death ke baad VP V V Giri 'acting President' bane. Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed (1977) ki death par VP B D Jatti acting President bane.

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: History wala module bhi clear! Ab dekhte hain VP ki salary aur privileges kya hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, guess karo - VP ki salary kis roop mein aati hai? Kya use ek alag 'VP salary' milti hai, jaise President ko milti hai?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan sir, VP itna bada pad hai to usko alag se fix salary jarur milti hogi!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Yahin twist hai Raju! Constitution mein VP ke liye koi alag salary fix nahi ki gayi hai. Use salary milti hai uske 'Rajya Sabha Chairman' wale role ke through - Salaries and Allowances of Officers of Parliament Act, 1953 ke tahat.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa! Matlab VP ki salary uski dusri job (RS Chairman) se aati hai, khud VP hone se nahi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi Raju! 2018 ke revision ke baad, VP (as Chairman, RS) ko current mein Rs 4,00,000 (4 lakh) prati mah milte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aur President ki salary kitni hai sir, taaki compare kar saku?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: President ko Rs 5,00,000 (5 lakh) prati mah milte hain, aur Governors ko Rs 3,50,000 (3.5 lakh). Ye teeno figures 2018 mein revise hui thi aur exam ke liye yaad rakhna zaroori hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 5 lakh President, 4 lakh VP, 3.5 lakh Governor - ye order to yaad rakhna aasan hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab ek connect-the-dots sawaal - jab VP 'acting President' ban jaata hai (jo humne pichhle module mein padha), to uski salary kya hogi - RS Chairman wali ya President wali?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir logically to President wali honi chahiye, kyunki wo President ka kaam kar raha hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi guess! Jab VP acting President hota hai, use President ki salary, allowances aur privileges milte hain, RS Chairman wali salary nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! To temporary duty ke saath temporary salary bhi badal jaati hai - makes sense sir!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab Warrant of Precedence ko thoda detail mein revise karte hain, jo humne shuruaat mein chhua tha. Order hai: 1) President, 2) Vice-President, 3) Prime Minister, 4) Governors (apne state ke andar) / Former Presidents.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, to Governor bhi apne state ke bahar VP se neeche hi rahenge?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi - Governor sirf apne state ke andar hi high protocol rakhta hai, VP to poore desh mein hamesha number 2 par hi rehta hai, President ke baad.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Samajh gaya sir! Ab lagta hai maine VP ka poora syllabus cover kar liya - bas ek baar list of VPs bhi dekh lena chahta hoon!

quiz_payload.question: VP ko salary kis roop mein milti hai?

options.text: Ek alag, Constitution mein fix 'VP salary' ke roop mein
Rajya Sabha Chairman ke roop mein, Salaries and Allowances of Officers of Parliament Act, 1953 ke tahat

quiz_payload.explanation: Constitution VP ke liye alag se salary fix nahi karta - VP apne 'RS Chairman' role se, 1953 ke Act ke tahat salary paata hai (current: Rs 4 lakh/maah).

quiz_payload.question: Jab VP 'Acting President' bante hain, tab unki salary kya hogi?

options.text: RS Chairman wali salary (4 lakh) hi rahegi
President ki salary aur privileges milenge

quiz_payload.explanation: Jab VP President ke functions discharge karte hain, unhe President ki salary, allowances aur privileges milte hain, apni RS Chairman wali salary nahi.

quiz_payload.question: Warrant of Precedence mein sahi kram (order) chuniye:

options.text: President > Vice-President > Prime Minister > Governor (apne state mein)

quiz_payload.explanation: Sahi kram hai: President (1), Vice-President (2), Prime Minister (3), Governors apne state ke andar / Former Presidents (4).

milestone_payload.title: MODULE COMPLETED!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Ek aur module clear! Ab last module mein sabhi VPs ki list aur PYQ trivia dekhते hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Chalo Raju, ab India ke pehle VP se milte hain - Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, jo 1952 se 1962 tak (do lagatar terms) VP rahe. Wo ek mahaan shikshak aur darshanik (philosopher) bhi the.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, VP ke baad wo kya bane? Kuch aur bhi to bane the na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut badhiya connect! Radhakrishnan VP ke baad India ke doosre President bhi bane (1962-1967). Aur unka janamdin, 5 September, 'Teachers' Day' ke roop mein manaya jaata hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wow, Teachers Day unke naam par hai! Ye to sabko pata hai, par VP wala fact naya laga mujhe.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Radhakrishnan akele nahi hain jo VP se President bane. Ab tak 3 VP aage jaakar President bhi bane hain - Dr. S. Radhakrishnan, Dr. Zakir Husain, aur V. V. Giri.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Teeno alag-alag saalon mein VP the na sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul - Zakir Husain VP the 1962-67, phir President bane 1967-69 (aur office mein hi guzar gaye). V V Giri VP the 1967-69, phir 1969 mein 'acting President' bhi bane, aur baad mein khud chunav jeetkar poora President bane 1969-74.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, matlab V V Giri ka double connection hai - pehle acting President, phir asli President bhi! Ye to yaad rakhna important hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab ek important aur thoda emotional fact - kya kabhi koi VP apne kaaryakaal (term) ke दौरान hi guzar gaya ho?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: President wale to sunne mein aaye the sir (Zakir Husain, Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed), VP ka bhi hua kya kabhi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan Raju, Krishan Kant, jo 10th VP the (1997-2002), unki office mein hi August 2002 mein death ho gayi thi. Wo abhi tak ke iतिhaas mein aisa इकलौta VP hain jinki mrityu pad par rehte hue hui.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha! Krishan Kant - इकलौta VP jo office mein guzre. Ye exact fact to bahut specific PYQ jaisa lag raha hai sir.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ab last important trivia - sabse lambe samay tak VP kaun rahe? Guess karo!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Radhakrishnan honge shaayad, wo 2 baar VP rahe the!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut close guess, lekin sahi jawab hai Mohammad Hamid Ansari - wo 2007 se 2017 tak, lagatar 2 terms, poore 10 saal VP rahe - ye sabse lamba record hai. Radhakrishnan bhi 10 saal (1952-62) rahe the, dono barabar hain 10-10 saal ke saath!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, dono barabar record par hain! Aur ek aur cheez sir - aaj tak koi mahila (woman) VP bani hai kya?

quiz_payload.question: Bharat ke pehle Vice-President kaun the, aur wo baad mein kaunsa aur bada pad grahan kiya?

options.text: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan - baad mein President bane
Dr. Zakir Husain - baad mein Prime Minister bane
V V Giri - baad mein Chief Justice bane
B D Jatti - baad mein Speaker bane

quiz_payload.explanation: Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan bharat ke pehle VP (1952-62) the aur baad mein 1962-67 tak bharat ke doosre President bhi bane.

quiz_payload.question: Kaunse VP ki mrityu unke kaaryakaal (term) ke दौरान hi ho gayi thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: Krishan Kant, 10va VP (1997-2002), abhi tak इकलौte VP hain jinki mrityu unke pad par rehte hue August 2002 mein hui.

quiz_payload.question: Sabse lambe samay tak Vice-President ke pad par rehne ka record kiske paas hai?

options.text: Mohammad Hamid Ansari aur Dr. S. Radhakrishnan (dono 10-10 saal)

quiz_payload.explanation: Mohammad Hamid Ansari (2007-2017) aur Dr. S. Radhakrishnan (1952-1962), dono lagatar 2 terms, poore 10-10 saal VP rahe - ye sabse lamba record hai.

summary_payload.title: ⚡ Officer Revision - Vice President ka Poora Nichod

revision_points.point: Article 63-71 (Part V). Qualification: Citizen, 35+ saal, RS membership yogya (na ki LS wali), koi office of profit nahi (President/Governor/Minister exempt).
VP chunav mein SIRF Parliament ke elected + nominated sadasya vote karte hain; State/UT Assembly (MLA/MLC) ka koi role nahi - President ke election se ye seedha ulta hai.

5 saal term, unlimited re-election. Shapath President dilaate hain (Article 69) - 'preserve, protect, defend' wali line NAHI hoti (jo President ki shapath mein hoti hai). Resignation President ko diya jaata hai. Removal sirf RS se shuru (Article 67(b)), RS mein effective majority + LS mein simple majority - ye 'impeachment' NAHI hai aur koi specific ground zaroori nahi.

VP ex-officio RS Chairman hai (Article 64) par RS ka sadasya NAHI - normal voting mein vote nahi deta, sirf tie hone par casting vote deta hai. RS akele use Chairman-ship se nahi hata sakti. Jab VP acting President banta hai (Article 65), Deputy Chairman RS ka kaam sambhalta hai aur VP ko President ki salary milti hai.

VP ki alag salary fix nahi hai - RS Chairman ke roop mein Rs 4 lakh/maah milte hain (President 5 lakh, Governor 3.5 lakh). Radhakrishnan pehle VP the aur baad mein President bhi bane; Krishan Kant इकलौte VP jo office mein guzre; Hamid Ansari & Radhakrishnan dono 10-10 saal ke record holder hain.

quiz_payload.question:
Nimnlikhit kathanon par vichar karein:
1) Vice President ke chunav ke Electoral College mein Rajya Sabha ke nominated sadasya vote de sakte hain.
2) State Vidhan Sabha ke elected sadasya VP ke chunav mein vote dete hain, jaise President ke chunav mein dete hain.
3) VP ko hataane ka resolution sirf Rajya Sabha mein hi shuru kiya jaa sakta hai, aur ismein koi specific ground batana zaroori nahi hai.
4) VP ki shapath mein Constitution ke 'preserve, protect and defend' karne ka wahi wada hota hai jo President leta hai.
Upayukt kathan chuniye:
quiz_payload.explanation: Kathan 1 sahi hai (nominated RS/LS members VP chunav mein vote de sakte hain). Kathan 2 GALAT hai - State Assembly ka VP chunav mein koi role nahi. Kathan 3 sahi hai - removal sirf RS se shuru, koi specific ground zaroori nahi (ye impeachment nahi hai). Kathan 4 GALAT hai - 'preserve, protect, defend' wali line sirf President ki shapath mein hoti hai, VP ki shapath mein nahi. Isliye sahi jawab hai kewal 1 aur 3.
